thread:
elaine: Heads-up — vendor just pushed H100 batch ETA from ~28 days -> 45 days. They also noted an RMA routing change for replacements, so split shipments are getting messy. Need quick plan on whether to expedite or split.
omar: ugh. what's the qty & burn? :eyes:
elaine: qty 24, committed to edge pools for April launches. current burn ~6 GPUs/week + 8 reserved for testing. If we accept 45d ETA we hit zero buffer in ~3 weeks.
kevin: can we reorder smaller split now and take rest later? vendor says split pallet requires extra AWB + customs handling. cost +$1,600 per pallet.
sylvia: cluster health snapshot: we have 2 failed nodes still in repair queue, patching recovers one. leaves ~4 hot spares across NA/EU. Not enough for a long gap.
elaine: vendor ops note — RMA flow for DOA now routes via their EU depot; NA returns cross-dock -> +3-5 days + customs hold risk. They require serial-level RMA tickets before replacements ship.
omar: options: 1) expedite full batch (cost quoted $42k), 2) split-air 6 units now (cost ~$9k + $1.6k pallet), 3) short-term partner loan pool for 8 units. Thoughts?
kevin: logistics math: expedite = $42k (priority freight + brokerage). split-air = $9k freight + $1.6k palletization + AWB fees. partner loans likely small ops cost but adds cross-region config.
sylvia: borrowing from APAC affects latency/regional constraints. EU/NA prod could see higher tail unless we reroute shards regionally. We can mitigate by serving critical traffic from EU nodes.
elaine: vendor also flagged RMA constraint: HWSERIAL mismatch policy — they want a per-unit RMA ticket (example name `RMA-APAC-42`) created before they dispatch replacements. ops-bot can create those but needs approval.
ops-bot: New RMA template ready. Paste to create:
```
RMA-TEMPLATE:
vendor: Frostline Logistics
model: H100-80GB
qty: <n>
reason: DOA / thermal
origin: NA-EWR
dest: EU-AMS
incoterms: DDP
```
omar: propose create `RMA-17585` for 6 units and ask vendor to hold until AWB confirmed — reduces rush fees if carrier can consolidate.
kevin: vendor holds free only 48h; after that warehouse fee = $75/day/pallet. Not ideal for multi-day holds.
elaine: my recommendation: split-air 6 units -> allocate to most critical edge clusters, open partner loan for 8 units to cover immediate burn, expedite remaining 10 if finance approves. Est total cost: split ~$10.6k + partner ops ~$2k + expedite $42k ~= $54.6k. Need greenlight from finance.
sylvia: soft fallback option: reduce inference capacity on non-critical endpoints and spin up quantized replicas to drop GPU demand ~30% — buys ~2 weeks.
omar: check PO terms: any early-cancel or deferral credits? vendor may give ~10% credit if we push part of PO to next quarter. worth asking.
elaine: pinging finance/cto in other thread. For this channel: @omar @kevin @sylvia please react with :thumbsup: to proceed with the split+loan+expedite plan or :thumbsdown: to re-evaluate.
kevin: :thumbsup: 
sylvia: :thumbsup: 
omar: :thumbsup: 
elaine: thanks — I'll open RMA-17585 and split the PO with vendor, request hold window, and await finance. Keeping updates here for AWB and RMA flow.
ops-bot: RMA created: RMA-17585. AWB pending. Carrier: SkySwift. Tracking to be posted when available.
kevin: once AWB posts I'll file customs/brokerage docs and arrange pickup. assign to me for brokerage.
elaine: noted. Updated procurement tracker: https://redwood.company/procure/PO-4821
sylvia: reassigning canary groups to degraded fallback now — reduced non-critical capacity by 35%.
omar: will follow up if partner loan or vendor hold runs into issues, will update this thread.
kevin: thanks — will post AWB when SkySwift confirms.
